The ID of the cloud phone matrix.

description.zh: 云手机矩阵下实例的串流模式，该参数不传默认为抢占模式。
description.en: Specifies the streaming mode for instances in the cloud phone matrix. If this parameter is left empty, the exclusive mode is used.

descriptions.zh: 修改云手机矩阵串流模式是异步接口，请勿频繁修改。
descriptions.en: Changing the streaming mode is an asynchronous operation. Please do not perform this action frequently.
